description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, as well as the main App component and CSS styles. It initializes the React app by creating a root element in the DOM and rendering the App component wrapped in React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the root container.
